gruss_morgen.text: An exquisite morning to you! The horse gentry have already dined. In proper style: from a bucket.

gruss_tag.text: Wilma von Wiehernstein, breeder in the third generation. The horses are nobility. I merely pretend.

gruss_abend.text: Good evening! The paddock is at rest. Only Count Gallop is still rolling about. He calls it his evening toilette.

gruss_regen.text: What a downpour! The horses are wearing mud today. They say it is very much in demand this season.

gruss_freund.text: Ah, my dearest soul! The herd has long since knighted you. You may wear the invisible crest.

hub.text: How may I be of service?

optionen.text: Why so formal with the horses?

text: The herd? Splendid. Baroness Trot cleared an obstacle today. It was a bucket.
We are celebrating anyway. Nobility obliges one to low standards at grand festivities.
Count Gallop has been asking about you. He snorts twice, which means: where is the good one?
One snort means food, by the way. Three snorts too. Frankly, almost everything means food.
Let me confess something: the von is invented. Wiehernstein is a boulder behind the stable.
But the horses firmly believe in our title. And who am I to contradict nobility?

quest_vergabe.text: Indeed! A matter of stately urgency. It concerns — naturally — horses.

quest_annahme.text: Splendid! The herd will thank you. Presumably by leaning on you. With their full weight.

ablehnung.text: But of course. Good things mature. Like cheese. Or pedigrees.

quest_abgabe.text: Excellently executed! I hereby knight you Knight of the Ranch. No need to kneel, there is manure here.

geschenk_liebt.text: Hay! The finest hay! You understand true luxury. The herd will turn pale with envy — I am not sharing.

geschenk_mag.text: How gallant! I accept it with both gloves. I own no gloves, but the gesture counts.

geschenk_normal.text: Ah. Unusual. I shall display it in the east wing. The east wing is a shelf.

text: The pedigree! Count Gallop's ancestor was the fastest horse in the valley. Allegedly.
In truth he only ran very fast once — from a bee. Three villages far.
By accident, he won the great race doing it. That, my friend, is how dynasties are born.
Why so formal? As a child I was tiny and the horses were enormous. I thought they were kings.
My first sentence to a horse was: Excuse me, Sir, might I pet you?
It nodded. I have kept it up ever since. One does not break a promise to a king.

tschuess.text: Farewell! The herd and I wave. The herd is eating, but inwardly it waves.
